characters.name: 苏绯

expressions.label: 打招呼
expressions.action: Warm hello. Open eyes, welcoming small smile; raise one open hand beside the face in a friendly greeting, other hand naturally resting by the characteristic prop.

expressions.label: 思考
expressions.action: Thoughtfully concentrating. Eyes glance gently upward to one side, mouth closed, one finger touches chin, characteristic prop held low by other hand; one small pale-gold thought sparkle. Keep a kind face.

expressions.label: 讲解
expressions.action: Patiently explaining a discovery. Attentive open eyes and small speaking mouth; one index finger raised in a clear teaching gesture, characteristic prop cradled by other arm; one tiny gold idea sparkle.

expressions.label: 认可
expressions.action: Pleased approval. Clear small thumbs-up and gentle confident smile with open eyes; other arm holds characteristic prop close. Quiet positive energy.

expressions.label: 疑惑
expressions.action: Lovably puzzled by a challenging question. Slight head tilt, subtly uneven eyebrows, small uncertain mouth, one hand touching cheek, prop in other arm; one very small floating question-mark symbol, no other text.

expressions.label: 加油
expressions.action: Reassuring encouragement. Both eyes warmly open and hopeful smile; a small encouraging fist raised near chest, other hand holds characteristic prop. A couple small warm gold sparkles; friendly and supportive.

expressions.label: 开心
expressions.action: Delighted by a student's breakthrough. Bright eyes curved in a joyful smile, modest open laughing mouth, a small celebratory hand gesture, characteristic prop securely held; tiny gold star accents. Keep recognizable face.

expressions.label: 再见
expressions.action: Warm farewell. Slight head tilt, tender smiling open eyes, one open hand raised in a relaxed waving gesture with small motion arcs; other hand holds characteristic prop. Peaceful and friendly.
